scope: Read-only review of the user-provided cropped screen recording and retained SDK input/decision logs. No new capture, device access, human passage, source edit or tuning.
supplements_snapshot: review01.json; prior snapshots and unresolved-path fields are retained as historical records

video.location: Mac user workspace; native camera originals remain on Windows
video.review_method: AVFoundation exact-time extraction at clip seconds 0 through 9; full-size visual review of 0,2,3,4 and overview of all ten samples

visual_observations.observation: Person stands fully within preview; lower-body skeleton is visible; the initial empty lead-in is ending.
Person is moving toward the left of preview. Foot/ankle approaches or crosses the lower image boundary; visible UI prompts report missing foot landmarks and body filling the frame.
Person is partly clipped at left/lower image edges; first footprint is visible. UI says SDK follow is paused pending a fresh reliable full-body target.
Person has left the preview. Camera image continues to show the scene and footprints continue to accumulate.
Preview remains on the empty scene while footstep metrics and footprint display continue to update. Final visible valid_steps=6 is distinct from ten published/painted contacts.

alignment_limit: Clip begins near the end of the 5-second lead-in and its displayed elapsed labels progress approximately 6..14 seconds. No shared recorder-clock anchor is available; clip seconds are not equated precisely with host/QPC or physical movement time. Preview itself may be delayed.

SDK_log_sequence.API_calls_scope: Logged calls returned without an error; result None is the Python wrapper return. No gimbal-angle feedback or physical-motion delivery measurement is available.

frozen_tracking_rule.meaning: Both shoulders, hips and ankles must have finite coordinates in [0,1] and visibility/presence at least 0.65. body_framing returns None otherwise; mailbox returns invalid_target and runtime requests zero speed. Missing pose then produces no_pose and zero speed.

assessment.immediate_pause_trigger_supported: The preceding pose packet has model left-ankle y=1.0247029066, outside the image, with the other five required landmarks passing. This matches the frozen invalid-target rule and the subsequent zero-speed request.
assessment.initial_failure_to_keep_person_in_frame: Unresolved: framing geometry, actual pan/pitch delivery, motion response and pose behavior have not been independently separated. SDK call completion alone does not verify physical camera movement.
assessment.continued_frame_and_footprint_updates: Observed in sampled screen frames; no claim of zero capture/display latency or whole-system freedom from stalls.
assessment.CPU_GIL_Qt_root_cause: No attribution; no native stacks were captured in this OFF trial

next_step: Review existing framing/physical-motion evidence before deciding on further field work; no additional human round or automatic parameter change is scheduled.
